title: AWS buys Talen's Cumulus data center campus next to Susquehanna for $650M

sources.quote: In March 2024, AWS purchased substantially all the assets of Cumulus Data and certain other assets for gross proceeds of $650 million.
Cumulus Digital (a Talen subsidiary) has now received all funds previously held in escrow under the terms of the transaction.

explain: Amazon Web Services paid Talen $650 million for the Cumulus data center campus (land, power infrastructure and buildings) next to the Susquehanna nuclear plant in Pennsylvania; $300M was held in escrow until development milestones were met in August 2024. Plant next door: Susquehanna Steam Electric Station.
